deferred_verification.description: RAW-verify foreign-flow coverage widened from the 111-code watchlist+referenceStocks subset to the full daily_ohlcv traded universe (~1459 codes live), after mcp-server is rebuilt+swapped AND the VPS re-deploys the updated vps-scripts/fetch-foreign-flow.sh (apps/mcp-server/deploy-vinahost.sh sed-templates __MCP_BASE__/__API_KEY__ into the script at deploy time — no separate deploy-vinahost.sh change was needed for the new CODES_URL placeholder). Run during VN market hours (09:00-15:00 ICT) so bgapidatafeed returns live non-zero foreign-flow values.
deferred_verification.check: 1) curl -s -H "X-API-Key: $VPS_PUSH_API_KEY" https://<mcp-base>/api/ohlcv-codes | jq '.count' -> expect ~1400-1600 (matches SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT code) FROM daily_ohlcv on the live DB). 2) Deploy the updated fetch-foreign-flow.sh to the VPS (or confirm auto-deploy already ran) and check /var/log/vn-foreign-flow.log for a 'Code list loaded (ohlcv-codes): N codes' line (N >> 111) — confirms the script picked the new primary source, not the watchlist fallback. 3) SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT code) FROM daily_ohlcv WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM daily_ohlcv) AND foreign_net_vol IS NOT NULL -> expect a count that grows meaningfully above the pre-fix baseline (~97-102) over the course of a trading day as the code coverage widens (coverage is gated by daily_ohlcv row existence for that code+date, not just the fetch — see market-data.md Invariant 8). 4) Spot-check a non-watchlist, non-referenceStocks code (e.g. one NOT in mcp.config.json market.referenceStocks and NOT in the watchlist table) now has a non-NULL foreign_net_vol for the latest trading date. 5) Confirm foreign_buy_value/foreign_sell_value are populated (VND) for that same expanded coverage set and that get_foreign_flow renders 'Mua ròng (VND, ...)' tỷ đồng lines for it.
deferred_verification.acceptance: distinct codes with foreign_net_vol NOT NULL for date=latest is >> 102 (pre-fix baseline) and grows with daily_ohlcv coverage; at least one non-watchlist code confirmed with non-NULL foreign_net_vol + foreign_buy_value/foreign_sell_value; get_foreign_flow serves VND for that code.

notes: Root cause (docs/handoffs/AUDIT-FC-FOREIGN-FLOW-recon.md): CODES list submitted to bgapidatafeed.vps.com.vn/getliststockdata/<CODES> was built only from watchlist DB + mcp.config.json referenceStocks (~111 codes) -> ~1457 of ~1569 daily_ohlcv traded tickers carried foreign_net_vol=NULL permanently. Fix: new GET /api/ohlcv-codes route (apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/routes/ohlcvBackfillHandler.ts, handleOhlcvCodes) serves SELECT DISTINCT code FROM daily_ohlcv (no hardcoded list) — this also closes a pre-existing dormant gap where vps-scripts/fetch-ohlcv-backfill.sh's R-2 fallback chain already expected this endpoint but it had never been implemented (confirmed 404 in docs/vps-sources/ohlcv-backfill-pipeline-stall/recon.md). vps-scripts/fetch-foreign-flow.sh now sources CODES from /api/ohlcv-codes first, falling back to /api/watchlist if unreachable (mirrors fetch-ohlcv-backfill.sh's existing R-2 pattern). PAYLOAD_SIZE_THRESHOLD raised 50000->3000000 and the bgapidatafeed fetch timeout raised 60s->90s to match the ~13x larger code list (live-tested off-market-hours 2026-07-10: 1459 codes -> HTTP 200, 1400 items returned, ~1.2MB, ~7s from a non-VPS host — no pagination at the source, confirmed). Money-value extraction (fBValue/fSValue -> foreign_buy_value/foreign_sell_value columns, VND tỷ đồng served via get_foreign_flow) was ALREADY implemented in a prior commit (ddc36452e, 2026-06-16) — verified live via docker exec query against the running mcp-server container; no further work needed on that half of the task. New tests: FIX-FOREIGN-FLOW-COVERAGE.test.ts (5/5 pass) exercising auth, empty-DB, full-universe coverage (not watchlist-bounded), DISTINCT dedup, and the exact non-watchlist-code scenario this task fixes. bun test 78/78 pass on the targeted foreign-flow + ohlcv-backfill suite, tsc clean, tool count 183 unchanged, server-boot + dashboard circular-dep probes clean. Container still running the pre-change image — per feedback_user_gates_delegate_to_ops.md / feedback_container_swaps_user_gated.md the docker compose up -d --build mcp-server swap is USER-GATED and was NOT run by dev-mcp-server. This signal tracks the deferred live-rebuild + VPS-script-redeploy + market-hours RAW-verify. Do not close FIX-FOREIGN-FLOW-COVERAGE as DONE_VERIFIED until ops confirms both the mcp-server rebuild and the VPS script redeploy, and a market-hours check confirms non-watchlist codes get non-NULL foreign_net_vol.
